title: Reorganize String
summary: Rearrange all characters of s so no neighboring positions contain the same character.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–500 lowercase English letters. Every occurrence must be retained. Output is checked semantically, not against one chosen arrangement.
contractDetails.output-checking: Require an exact character multiset and unequal adjacent characters. Accept any valid rearrangement. Accept the empty string only if no arrangement exists.

statement: Rearrange all characters of s so no neighboring positions contain the same character. Return any valid arrangement, or an empty string if none exists.

examples.explanation: All characters are retained without equal neighbors.
Three zs cannot be separated by only one y.
A single character already satisfies the condition.

constraints: 1–500 lowercase English letters. Every occurrence must be retained. Output is checked semantically, not against one chosen arrangement.
hints: Conceptual: Repeated letters need other letters between them.
Directional: Prefer the most frequent available letter that differs from the previous letter.
Implementation: Keep counts and repeatedly choose a permitted largest count, decrementing it after writing. If no letter is permitted while entries remain, return an empty string.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time for the fixed 26-letter alphabet and O(1) auxiliary frequency storage, excluding output.
